hypotheses.title: Fundamental Multi-Factor Style Surface Acceleration & Price Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures corporate turning points via the first derivative / acceleration of the comprehensive fundamental style surface (Value, Growth, Profitability, Quality). Because the user has zero approved alphas in model16, this signal possesses zero self-correlation against the user's existing portfolio while delivering high global Uniqueness.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if accelerating style surfaces experience immediate fundamental mean-reversion.

hypotheses.title: Fundamental Balance Sheet Quality & Resilience with Price Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Ranks balance sheet resilience, debt sustainability, and earnings quality (fscore_bfl_quality) relative to subindustry peers. Provides defensive outperformance with zero historical overlap in the user's submitted portfolio.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high-quality balance sheet firms suffer unexpected liquidity crunches.

hypotheses.title: Idiosyncratic Unsystematic Variance Contraction & Price Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures institutional stabilization where short-term 90-day unsystematic variance sharply contracts relative to 1-year baseline. Combining this risk model signal with 5-day delta mean reversion guarantees zero self-correlation and top-tier Uniqueness (> 0.90) on the country-level challenge leaderboard.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if variance contraction signals operational stagnation rather than stability.
